Provider facts come from GitHub's and Vercel's public documentation and official OpenAPI descriptions, fetched unauthenticated on 2026-09-23, and from the committed RC-9a executor record.
OWNER_AUTHORIZATION: LRW-2: INFRA_LINK_REPO_WITNESS_INVENTORY_READ = AUTHORIZED, recorded verbatim in the owner decision record. It supersedes only the witness ROUTE of LRW-1 (whose ID-keyed condition failed); LRW-1's record is unchanged.

DOCUMENTED_PROVIDER_CAPABILITY.operation: GET /user/repos, operationId repos/list-for-authenticated-user, 'List repositories for the authenticated user'
sources: https://docs.github.com/en/rest/repos/repos (the operation, its parameters and its token section)
DOCUMENTED_PROVIDER_CAPABILITY.semantics: Lists repositories the authenticated user has explicit permission (read, write or admin) to access: owned, collaborator, and reachable through an organization membership.

parameters_not_used.visibility / affiliation / type: defaults (all; owner,collaborator,organization_member) define the COMPLETE authorized set; a filter could hide a legitimate target
parameters_not_used.sort / direction: documented default full_name ascending gives a deterministic order

DOCUMENTED_PROVIDER_CAPABILITY.pagination_model: Page-numbered. The traversal requests page 1, 2, ... in order and completes only on an EMPTY page. The documented Link header is not read (reading response headers would require gh's --include, which the executor forbids), so completion is established by the empty page, never by a short page.
DOCUMENTED_PROVIDER_CAPABILITY.response_fields_used: id (integer, 'Unique identifier of the repository'), name, full_name, owner.login; all four are required in the specified schema.
DOCUMENTED_PROVIDER_CAPABILITY.responses: 200, 304, 401, 403, 422; any non-200 STOPs. Rate limiting surfaces as 403 or 429 and STOPs.

AUTH_PRINCIPAL_COMPATIBILITY.runtime_principal: The GitHub CLI's OAuth-app user token (gho_ class, keyring storage), as recorded by the RC-9a executor record and re-measured by runtime RC-9a on every execution. It is a user-context token carrying classic OAuth scopes; it is not a GitHub App installation token.
AUTH_PRINCIPAL_COMPATIBILITY.documented_support: The endpoint works with user-context tokens: the official page lists GitHub App user access tokens and fine-grained personal access tokens (Metadata: read). It does NOT list installation access tokens (x-github.enabledForGitHubApps = false), and none is used. For classic-scope tokens (OAuth apps, classic PATs), GitHub's scope documentation states that no scope grants read-only access to public information and that 'repo' grants access to private repositories.

PERMISSION_CONTRACT.required: Classic OAuth scope 'repo' (to include private linked repositories).
PERMISSION_CONTRACT.not_a_widening: The credential already holds 'repo' (RC-9a record; DF-13 recorded that these scopes can do more than the authority allows and that separation is by control). No new scope, token or principal is introduced.
PERMISSION_CONTRACT.rc9a_change: Runtime RC-9a PLANE-G now REQUIRES 'repo' among the provider-reported scopes (protocol.ts REQUIRED_GITHUB_SCOPE). A credential without it STOPs (STOP_RC9_UNRESOLVED) before any read, instead of failing later as a zero match.

G_R5.read_class: ONE. Page requests are invocations of the same class, not separate classes.
G_R5.endpoint_shape: gh api --method GET /user/repos?per_page=100&page=N, exact-shape guarded: path pattern ^/user/repos?per_page=100&page=[1-9][0-9]{0,2}$.
G_R5.input: ONLY the page number, validated digits-only 1..999 without sign or leading zero. link.repo, link.org and link.repoId never reach the URL, path, query, headers or body: the builder has no access to them, and the exact-shape guard refuses any other query key or path.
G_R5.when: Only when the SAME run's V-R2.S2 has deferred at least one finding (see SCANNER_ADJUDICATION). Otherwise it is recorded NOT_REQUIRED and not executed.
G_R5.order: V-R2.S1 -> V-R2.S2 (+ S3) for every team -> G-R5 pages 1..N to completion -> verdict -> V-R1, V-R3, V-R2 limbs, X-R1. No later read runs while a finding is unadjudicated.
G_R5.multi_project: The target set is every deferred project of V-R2.S2 in this run (keyed by repoId; several projects may share one). ONE traversal serves all targets; each target requires its own exactly-one identity.
G_R5.projection: Per item: id, name, full_name, owner.login (allowlist pinned by test). Each page is reduced IN MEMORY to target matches before any scan, record or log; non-matching repositories are discarded at once.
G_R5.memory_bound: Retained: the target set, at most the matched identities per target, and control metadata (next page, completion flag, first/last id and count of the previous page for loop detection). Never the inventory. Tested at 9,900 repositories.
G_R5.page_cap: 100 pages (10,000 repositories); exceeding it STOPs rather than truncating.

SAME_RUN_WITNESS.binding: ALL of: numeric link.repoId === id (structural: matches are keyed by id); link.type === 'github'; link.repo === name; link.org === owner.login; full_name === owner.login + '/' + name; exactly one match per repoId across the COMPLETE traversal.
SAME_RUN_WITNESS.case_rules: Strict string equality. No case folding or trimming: no provider documentation justifies normalizing, so a case difference STOPs.
SAME_RUN_WITNESS.failure: 401, 403, 404, 429 / rate limit, timeout or missing status, malformed JSON or page, item missing or malformed id / name / full_name / owner.login, page larger than per_page, a repeated page (loop), the page cap, an out-of-order or post-completion page, zero match, multiple match, id / name / owner / full_name / type mismatch, an incomplete traversal, or any UNKNOWN: STOP fail-closed.
SAME_RUN_WITNESS.cross_run_isolation: The witness, the pending set and the adjudicated-value set are instance state of the executor; every execution constructs a new executor and starts empty. Previous G-R reads, a previous V-R2, committed evidence, cached inventories and fixtures cannot satisfy it: the only way in is ingestPage from this executor's own G-R5 pages.

SCANNER_ADJUDICATION.scan_first: The post-projection scan runs unchanged. With no finding, nothing changes.
SCANNER_ADJUDICATION.deferrable: ONLY at V-R2.S2, and only if EVERY finding of that projection is OPAQUE_HIGH_ENTROPY at exactly projects[*].link.repo, the leaf itself trips no other detector, and its project carries link.type 'github', a positive integer link.repoId, a non-empty link.org and an id. Anything else STOPs at once with the certified safe diagnostic.
SCANNER_ADJUDICATION.pending: A deferred record is marked PENDING_SAME_RUN_WITNESS and is NOT validated evidence; the entry point cannot write it.
SCANNER_ADJUDICATION.pass: Witness PASS replaces it by a validated record whose scanner_adjudications say classification EXPECTED_PROVIDER_IDENTIFIER, basis SAME_RUN_AUTHENTICATED_REPOSITORY_INVENTORY_ID_MATCH.
SCANNER_ADJUDICATION.other_detectors: Never adjudicated: token prefixes, userinfo, authorization / bearer, private keys, credential assignments and every other detector STOP exactly as before, including on link.repo. OPAQUE_HIGH_ENTROPY itself is unchanged (no threshold, length, regex or value exception).

supersedes.superseded_text_verbatim: TI-2: the returned link.repo MUST equal lorenzozanello/uellix-antigravity. If it does not, the measured setting does not govern this repository and the entire production-boundary analysis would be about a different codebase. This is DN-1's MIN-1_the_three_fields_that_must_come_back_together, carried as a hard assertion.

evidence_for_the_correction: Vercel's official OpenAPI (GET /v9/projects/{idOrName}, GitHub link variants) gives link separate 'org' and 'repo' string fields plus a numeric 'repoId'; with the owner held in 'org', 'repo' carries the repository name.
The installed Vercel CLI 54.14.2 pairs project.link.org with project.link.repo.
The certified safe diagnostic of the observed V-R2.S2 hit reported slash_count = 0, inconsistent with an owner/name form.
The owner decision LRW-2 defines the binding link.repo === repository.name.
TI2_CORRECTION.residual_uncertainty: Vercel's specification gives the fields no descriptions. The corrected TI-2 therefore fails closed: if Vercel in fact returns an owner/name link.repo, V-R1 STOPs (STOP_PROJECT_IDENTITY_MISMATCH) and nothing is concluded.
TI2_CORRECTION.rule: NORMATIVE. TI-2 holds iff link.type === 'github', link.org === 'lorenzozanello', link.repo === 'uellix-antigravity' and link.repoId === the repository id G-R1 returned in THIS run. It is ENFORCED on V-R1 (STOP_PROJECT_IDENTITY_MISMATCH), where v1.0.4-v1.0.6 only recorded it.
TI2_CORRECTION.historical_note: The CM-6 measurement text in the release-control amendment is not edited.

OPERATION_REGISTRY.unchanged: V-R4 remains F_IMMEDIATE_ONLY_BEFORE_MUTATION. No other operation is added.

EVIDENCE_MODEL.envelope: Every record gains scanner_adjudications (an empty array unless adjudicated); its entries have exactly {normalized_schema_path, project_id, detector_id, classification, basis} in the single permitted form.
EVIDENCE_MODEL.g_r5_record: ONE witness record: {pages_traversed, terminal: EMPTY_PAGE, matched: [{id, owner.login}]}. The matched repository NAME is not duplicated (it is already the adjudicated V-R2.S2 field). Page records, the inventory and non-matching repositories never become evidence.
EVIDENCE_MODEL.ec1: The entry point's evidence scan now runs EC-1 in-run at both levels (serialized and decoded leaves / keys). A finding is explained only by a V-R2.S2 adjudication marker for that project, OPAQUE_HIGH_ENTROPY at that exact leaf or quoted value, no other detector on the value, and the executor's in-memory same-run witness. scripts/infra-read/evidence-adjudication.ts is also a standalone pre-commit CLI; outside the run it can only honour the executor's markers.

EVENT_CHAIN_SUCCESSOR.rule: NORMATIVE. dn0ConfigFor binds FIVE events: the effective-authority IC (455b5426), the arming-package IC (3dc12909), the executor base recert (fixed to 81b56ed4), the diagnostic recert (fixed to 4a3c2837), and the DELTA recert of the executed candidate at docs/ops/release/CV1_INFRA_CONTROL_PLANE_READ_EXECUTOR_DELTA_RECERT_<first 12 hex of the candidate, upper case>_IC_v1.0.0.json, package_id CV1_INFRA_CONTROL_PLANE_READ_EXECUTOR_DELTA_RECERT_IC.
EVENT_CHAIN_SUCCESSOR.why: v1.0.6 bound the diagnostic-recert path to the supplied candidate; that file is now materialized for 4a3c2837 and is append-only, so this candidate could never arm through it. The delta-recert path is derived from each candidate, so no append-only event is ever asked to certify a SHA it does not name, and the dead end cannot recur. The name is in the allowedPostCertificationAdditions class.
EVENT_CHAIN_SUCCESSOR.successor_duty: A later delta pins this candidate's delta recert as a fixed historical event (as this delta pins 81b56ed4 and 4a3c2837).
EVENT_CHAIN_SUCCESSOR.materialization_contract: After the short recertification of this delta: the file at the derived path for the recertified head, package_id CV1_INFRA_CONTROL_PLANE_READ_EXECUTOR_DELTA_RECERT_IC, authority_class prefix INDEPENDENT_CERTIFICATION_EVENT_RECORD, CERTIFIED_CANDIDATE.candidate_head = that head, the verdict copied verbatim, blocking_findings the integer reported.

MUTATION_RESULTS.method: scripts/infra-read/mutation-battery.mjs on the final tree, in three chunks (the full battery exceeds the 10-minute command cap): unmutated suite green first (351/351), each production mutant applied, tests/infra-read run, file restored from an in-memory byte copy and SHA-verified.
MUTATION_RESULTS.aggregate: MUTANTS=90 (M01-M18, N01-N30, D01-D10, W01-W32) AS_EXPECTED=90 UNEXPECTED=0 BATTERY=PASS; SELF_TEST=PASS (BATTERY=FAIL on a real survivor).
equivalence_notes: The verdict-time id equality (gh.id !== repoId) is structurally redundant: matches are KEYED by the provider id, so it cannot differ. W09 therefore mutates the binding itself (a name match stored under the target id) and is killed.

The detector restriction on a deferred link.repo has two layers (the serialized finding must be OPAQUE_HIGH_ENTROPY; the decoded leaf must trip no other detector). Either layer alone suffices, so W19 removes both together.
A broadened G-R5 projection has no observable effect because each page is reduced before any record; the allowlist is therefore pinned by an exact test, which kills W22.
